title: Finite AM syntax coordination projection
question: For every accepted research-local AMTerm in the declared finite budget, can one constructor-by-constructor projection preserve exact constructor order and every bound leaf while counting a BalancedZero dual as a view rather than a second occurrence?
types: Exact project-original frozen dataclass constructors and ordinary string fields from the PR #217 research model
quantifiers: Every node visited by the accepted term, at most 256 formation nodes and depth 32, with at most 256 cumulative dual-comparison pairs and comparison depth 32; plus an exhaustive depth-two calibration over four fixed leaf terms and all nine constructors
arithmetic_domain: none; no evaluator, scalar, equality, additive-zero or multiplicative-unit semantics
candidate_grammar: Atom | Hole | Use | EmptyZero | PolarDual | Plus | Tensor | BalancedZero | HistoryComposition
projection_fields: authoritative source occurrence and multiplicity ledger
acceptance: one term containing all nine constructors has the exact expected projection
a fresh independently named source reuses the same constructor signature without reusing identities
HistoryComposition order and Plus/Tensor constructor distinctions remain visible
BalancedZero contributes one positive leaf traversal and one dual-view marker, not a second Use
invalid source, duplicate occurrence, mismatched dual and invalid WholeCut6 residual ledger are refused before projection
the exhaustive declared depth-two family has no projection collision between distinct accepted terms
the complete Bootstrap Zero suite, lint, format, research index and publication boundary pass
forbidden_conflations: structured syntax projection with denotational semantics
constructor faithfulness with arithmetic equality or distributivity
BalancedZero dual view with copying, cancellation or additive zero
HistoryComposition order with temporal composition or invertibility
finite depth-two injectivity with unrestricted grammar completeness
pairwise syntax coordination with all-fillings coverage or M6 filler
research Python projection with Rust authority, stable API or native free
stop: Stop after the exact positive, reuse, refusal and exhaustive finite checks pass or after one implementation correction; retain any remaining failure as Unknown.
residual: The broader WholeCut6 theorem for every built-in view and morphism, Rust correspondence, 0090 coverage, 0092 generation/promotion/reuse, semantic interpreters and practical task value remain open.
